prefeito.comoAssumiu: Presidente da Câmara Municipal, tomou posse como prefeito interino em 18/06/2026, depois que a Justiça Eleitoral cassou os mandatos do prefeito Reginaldo Marcomini e da vice Vanja Sabino, eleitos em 2024. Na eleição suplementar de 25/10/2026, foram eleitos Vado (PSD), prefeito, e Pedro Antônio (PSD), vice; eles tomam posse depois da diplomação pela Justiça Eleitoral.
prefeito.comoAssumiu_en: As president of the City Council, he was sworn in as acting mayor on June 18, 2026, after the Electoral Courts revoked the terms of Mayor Reginaldo Marcomini and Vice Mayor Vanja Sabino, elected in 2024. In the special election held on October 25, 2026, Vado (PSD) was elected mayor and Pedro Antônio (PSD) vice mayor; they take office after being certified by the Electoral Courts.

vice.txt: O cargo de vice-prefeito está vago desde junho de 2026, quando a Justiça Eleitoral cassou os mandatos do prefeito e da vice eleitos em 2024. Pedro Antônio (PSD), eleito vice-prefeito na eleição suplementar de 25/10/2026, toma posse junto com o prefeito eleito.
vice.txt_en: The office of vice mayor has been vacant since June 2026, when the Electoral Courts revoked the terms of the mayor and vice mayor elected in 2024. Pedro Antônio (PSD), elected vice mayor in the special election held on October 25, 2026, takes office together with the mayor-elect.

aviso_en: Who is in office today was checked by hand, using the sources shown. The winners of the special election held on October 25, 2026 take office after being certified by the Electoral Courts; until then, the city is run by the person shown below, checked by hand on October 29, 2026.
